ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT BY ANDBETWEEN NY 1140 LLC AND 916 HOME REALTY LLC BRONX COUNTY BL0CK 2719 LOTS46&49 Dated: as ofFebruary 13,2023 RECORDANDRETURNTO: Law Officeof Jay Goldstein,PLLC ATTENTION:Jay Goldstein,ESQ. 555WillowAvenue Cedarhurst,NY 11516

ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT made as of the 13th day of February, 2023, by and between NY 1140 LLC, a New York Limited Liability Company, having an office at 56 Van Arsdale Road, Monroe, NY 10950 (hereinafter "Owner"), and 916 Home Realty LLC, a New York Limited Liability Company, having an office at 320 5th avenue, Suite 611, New York, NY 10001 (hereinafter “Developer") (Owner and Developer are sometimes hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Bronx, County of Bronx, City and State of New York, known as and by the street address 1140 Fox Street, as more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof and known as Tax Block 2719, Lot 46 (the "Owner Land"; the buildings and improvements located thereon or which may be located thereon in the future are herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Bronx, County of Bronx, City and State of New York, known as and by the street address 916 Homes Street, as more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof and known as Tax Block 2719, Lot 49 (the "Developer Land", said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein collectively called the "Developer Building," and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct one or more new buildings on all or a portion of the Developer Land (each, a “New Developer Building"), with a bulk that would be in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), if the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are certain “Development Rights” (as hereinafter defined) appurtnenat to the Owner Land that are in excess of the “Retained Development Rights” (as hereinafter defined) and that are available for transfer in accordance with the Zoning Resolution (the“Excess Development Rights"); WHEREAS, Owner and Developer intend to make the “Subject Development Rights"(as hereinafter defined) available for utilization in connection with the construction of the NewDeveloperBuilding; 2
